title: Layer 3 round 5 major SE+QE convergent: the post_load loader wiring is unpinned — deleting value.post_load() leaves all tests green (the unit test pins the logic, nothing pins the call); plus the missing #789 hostile-path falsifier (record corrected on #795)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 52f94321: the post_load LOADER WIRING is pinned by load_set_cleans_registry_display_strings_at_load — it doctors a temp statusline-data artifact with a zero-width char in next_step_text (pattern-free, minLength-1, so it passes schema), loads through the real load_set, and asserts the loaded field is clean; deleting value.post_load() now turns it red. The missing #789 hostile-path falsifier is added (the broken-state test seeds a Diagnostic with a bidi/control file path and asserts both surfaces clean). Both gaps the round named are closed.
